text: 雨停后，你把学生们召集到洞口，简短地发表了一番鼓舞人心的讲话。队员们各自提出接下来的行动建议。查理和伯纳德强调，可以把这个避风的洞穴作为基地，探索周边环境；西尔维娅和诺曼则希望继续前进。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 31
text: Once the rain stops, you gather the students in the cave mouth and make a short inspirational speech to raise their spirits. Your party offers suggestions about the best way to proceed. Charlie and Bernard emphasize the advantages of the sheltered cave as a base to explore the local environment; Sylvia and Norman would like to keep moving.
